# soapysdr-module-plutosdr

**SoapySDR driver module for the ADALM-Pluto**

- **Version recorded:** 0.2.2
- **Categories:** `hardware`, `sdr`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/pothosware/SoapyPlutoSDR>

## What it does

A plugin for SoapySDR that makes the Analog Devices ADALM-Pluto usable through the generic SoapySDR interface, over the network link the device presents rather than through a character device.

## Why you would want it

Without it, SoapySDR-based software cannot see a Pluto at all. With it, the same applications that drive an RTL-SDR or a HackRF will drive a Pluto.

## Before it will work

An ADALM-Pluto, and libiio, which the Pluto is reached through. On Debian 13 and Parrot this package is simply not available — see known problems.

## How it installs

- apt: `soapysdr-module-plutosdr` — *on kali*
  - Kali only. Absent from Debian 13 and Parrot, where this package resolves to nothing at all — it is in Debian unstable and has not reached stable.

## Known problems

Not packaged for Debian 13 or Parrot, only for Kali. On a stable Debian base there is currently no apt route to Pluto support in SoapySDR, and this manifest says so rather than shipping an untested source build. The Pluto is also a composite device reached over its USB network interface, so it does not fit the single-device-node model most of this catalog assumes.

## Keeping it current

- probe: apt policy
- strategy: apt_upgrade
